title: Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Salaryman Tsuyoshi Mukouda is accidentally pulled into a fantasy kingdom alongside three summoned teenage 'Heroes'. Suspecting the kingdom wants to use them in its war, he slips away with a seemingly useless skill, an 'Online Supermarket' that delivers modern Japanese groceries. His cooking wins over a legendary wolf, Fel, then more familiars and even a group of goddesses, and the story follows their food-centered travels.
life_message: A good life is a modest, comfortable one shared with companions over good food, avoiding being used by the powerful.

content.note: Familiars hunt monsters and fight bandits; mostly quick and comic (Wikipedia plot; AniList Dragons, Dungeon).
Brief danger from monsters; iyashikei tone (AniList Iyashikei 77).
Little romance; MangaUpdates lists slavery and sexual-violence categories, likely backstory or novel content (to verify).
Mukouda buys beer and liquor for gods who request it (to verify).
Cooking with modern goods; little to imitate harmfully.
Shopping from a modern supermarket is the central device; real product types featured (Wikipedia plot; to verify brand use).

dominant: Pragmatism; food as comfort; found family of familiars
